description: This file defines the ContentType interface within the ContentTypes namespace, specifying methods for handling different content types in the Daux documentation generator project.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Interface defining methods for content type processing, including getting supported extensions and converting raw content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the content type with a configuration object.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an array of file extensions supported by this content type.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts raw content into the desired output format, given a content node.
